title: 市场越波动：银行越赚钱？，交易收入预计大增
speaker: Herman Chan

segments.en: You brought up the volatility that we've seen, a good segue to go back to Herman on what that does for the banks and the way the traders navigate this volatility and how that could be a boon for the bottom line. What do we expect this way?
segments.zh: 你提到了市场波动，正好回到赫尔曼这里：这对银行有何影响？交易员如何应对波动，这能否提振利润？我们有何预期？

segments.en: So we are expecting a big jump in trading revenues both on the equities and the big income side. You mentioned volatility, that's actually a helper for the month of March, given all the uncertainty in the markets, especially in areas like rates trading and businesses that were affected by the uncertainty.
segments.zh: 我们预计股票和固定收益交易收入将大幅增长。你提到的波动，实际上对三月有利，因为市场不确定性增加，尤其是在利率交易等领域。

segments.en: So banks like JP Morgan, Bank of America that had more thick revenues should bowed well for them for the first quarter. And Christine just kind of bridged our guests here. How important are bank earnings to markets and where do you see that really reflected the months?
segments.zh: 因此，像摩根大通、美国银行这样拥有更多固定收益收入的银行，第一季度表现应该不错。克里斯蒂娜，银行财报对市场有多重要？

segments.en: Extremely important. I mean, we're going to be watching it very closely as well. I think very much the steer for the rest of the market is, yeah, how much has this volatility kind of created opportunities for banks but also the consumer response as to him was alluded to because that is going to be a very important signal moving forward.
segments.zh: 极其重要。我们也会密切关注。我认为，对市场其他部分而言，关键在于波动为银行创造了多少机会，以及消费者的反应，这将是未来的重要信号。

segments.en: I think at the moment investors are kind of, they've digested the lay of the land at the moment, right? Higher oil prices, weighing on everything else. Now we're waiting for that second order consumer hit and what that's going to do consumption and just consumer visibility to spend their money if they have any money left moving forward. That's going to move a lot of market sentiments from here on out.
segments.zh: 我认为目前投资者已经消化了当前形势：油价上涨拖累其他一切。现在我们在等待第二轮消费冲击，以及消费者是否还有钱可花，这将影响未来的市场情绪。
